# PR #170 round 4 correctness verdict

**PASS-WITH-NOTES** at `b69cf96b6a6b6e9938f40a35f66ba66113fb4f52`.

**F004 is closed; all four reviewer findings are closed.** Warning output is no longer treated as positive clean/readable evidence for destructive pruning.

## Closure and scope

The status brake now spares a candidate on any stderr, including exit 0/empty stdout/unreadable-directory warning. A gh warning makes that PR's state unusable and spares its worktrees. Worktree-list or seat-list warnings reject the run before any removal.

The new quiet helper is scoped to the pruning reads. The existing must helper is unchanged, so this does not make ordinary freeze/fetch commands reject normal informational stderr.

The macOS-only gate, strict PR/seat decoding, complete lsof parsing, absolute-path resolution, 60-second child bounds and read-before-remove structure remain unchanged. No --force was added.

## Independent approved fake-IO proof

I reran the original F004 input at this exact head and killed all four stderr-guard mutants in session-only Node fixtures:

- warning-free valid data positively authorizes one fake removal;
- status and gh warnings spare with zero fake removals;
- worktree and seat warnings refuse with zero fake removals;
- removing each specific guard authorizes a fake removal and fails its safety expectation.

The seat-warning fixture carried a valid seats array, so a malformed-payload error could not mask a removed warning guard. All runners only recorded calls; no actual git/gh/pij/lsof invocation, process scan, live prune or physical removal occurred.

Exact-head CI **42433237523** passed. Node 22 executed all **33 pr-freeze tests**, with 2257 tests passed/six skipped overall. The new warning test and retained malformed-input, cwd, platform, timeout, runner and normal freeze controls pass.

The reviewed checkout is clean/detached, matches the remote full SHA, and GitHub reports CLEAN/ready with latest Delivers success. No repository edits, dependencies or vitest/local product runs were used for this review.

## Retained limits

- --prune is macOS-only and observes this user's process cwds, not every other user's process.
- Review ownership remains structural name/detached/head evidence, not an independent creation receipt.
- Usage is observed before removal, not held as an OS-level lease. A removal-stage timeout stops later attempts but is not rollback of an already-started operation.

No new blocking finding in the round-four delta. Security/performance acceptance remains independently owned.
